title: VIX futures and options October 2027 expiration (SOQ settlement) — the first tracked expiration to settle inside an FOMC blackout
source: EST: OCC'S OWN 2027 EXPIRATION CALENDAR, fetched and decoded in-session 2026-09-06, corroborated by the standing Cboe dating rule re-derived here. THE PUBLICATION: the Options Industry Council's backing JSON at www.optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) -- an artifact of The Options Clearing Corporation, per the footer "(c)2026 The Options Clearing Corporation. All rights reserved." and the same source this repo's opex-2027-09-17 entry cites -- carries the row {"date":"2027-10-20T00:00:00","events":[{"type":"EEF1643B-4D4D-4DCA-87AD-85A777B8ED66"}]}, and that GUID maps in the same document's own legend to "Monthly Volatility Products Expiration date". THE RULE, RE-DERIVED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: VIX futures and options settle on the Wednesday 30 days before the third Friday of the FOLLOWING calendar month, so that the settlement strikes the 30-day SPX strip exactly. November 2027's third Friday is 2027-11-19 (November 1 2027 is a Monday, so the Fridays are the 5th, 12th, 19th and 26th); 2027-11-19 minus 30 days is 2027-10-20, and 2027-10-20 is a WEDNESDAY -- the rule and the publisher's own calendar return the same date independently. Settlement is the special opening quotation struck in the 9:30 a.m. ET opening auction, the standing convention this calendar's other vix-expiration entries record and not a claim this session re-sourced. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not flip a status without an IR:/BLS:/FED: primary and a calendar fourteen months out remains subject to the publisher's amendment; the promotion trigger is cboe.com or theocc.com serving its own 2027 calendar to a session that can reach it. Discovered during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 initial research, checked 2026-09-06
notes: DISCOVERED during the fomc-blackout-start-2027-10-16 initial-research adjacency sweep (2026-09-06). THE HOLE: this calendar tracks VIX expirations at 2026-09-16 and then 2027-01-20, 02-17, 03-17, 04-21, 05-18 and 09-15, with nothing for June through August or October through December 2027. October's is proposed here because of where it FALLS, not to backfill the series. WHY IT MATTERS TO THE PARENT: 2027-10-20 is the third session inside the 2027-10-16 -> 2027-10-28 FOMC communications blackout, which makes it the first expiration this calendar tracks that SETTLES while no FOMC participant may speak -- the October 2027 VIX contract prices a 30-day forward window running 2027-10-20 to 2027-11-19 that contains the 2027-10-27 decision, and it fixes its own settlement level in an opening auction seven sessions before that decision with the official interpretation channel closed. THE ONE THING NOT TO CONCLUDE FROM IT: nothing about that geometry is measured here, and the parent ledger explicitly declined to build on it. The parent's finding is the opposite in spirit -- the October gate's boundary sessions run BELOW their own month's baseline (overhang 0.641x median, first post-gate session 0.697x, across 10 realized October gates), and the family's only direct test of a release landing inside a blackout, run by the consumer-confidence-2027-10-26 lane, returned 0 of 9 across SPY/QQQ/XLY/XRT/AMZN/AAPL/XLF/TLT/VIX. A lane taking this id should treat the in-blackout settlement as a QUESTION to measure against the other tracked expirations, not as an edge it has inherited. Impact low matches every other vix-expiration entry in this calendar. symbols is empty and no house playbook is calendar-keyed. Proposed as an estimate; estimates widen caution only and nothing here licenses an entry.
